sloka: तव सानुषु विश्रान्तः शेषं प्रक्रमतामिति ।तिष्ठ त्वं हरिशार्दूल मयि विश्रम्य गम्यताम् ॥५-१-११६॥
transliteration: tava sānuṣu viśrāntaḥ śeṣaṁ prakramatāmiti ।tiṣṭha tvaṁ hariśārdūla mayi viśramya gamyatām ॥5-1-116॥

translations.english: "I was prompted by the ocean for your sake since he has great regard for you. O great monkey you may rest here for a while and continue your journey. The lord of the ocean feels that this tiger among monkeys can cover the distance of a hundred yojanas. He tells me, 'let him rest on your peak and then cover the rest of the distance'.
translations.hindi: धर्मेजिज्ञासुग्रों के लिए तो एक साधारण अतिथि भी पूज्य है, फिर आपके समान गुणी ग्रतिथि का सत्कार करना तो मुझे सवंथा उचित ही है
